subject: Re: Purchase order follow-up
text:
Hi,

Following our earlier conversation, I checked the purchase order again. The vendor confirmed the replacement part shipped this morning, not this afternoon as we first assumed. Tracking is already available, and the expected arrival date moved two days earlier.

That is better news than we were expecting. I updated the shared tracker and added the invoice details for finance. The shipment includes the original accessory we were told would arrive later, so the whole order is complete.

If anything still looks off on your end, let me know and I can chase it now. Please let me know if you need confirmation.
